title: Asthma, COPD and the PCP's Bronchospasm Drugs
next: Chapter 29, Lesson 3: Pneumonia, pulmonary edema, clots, collapsed lungs and hyperventilation

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already sit asthma and COPD patients up, give oxygen, and give salbutamol by MDI or nebulizer. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Spot the infected upper airway and keep your hands off it
  2. Understand asthma and COPD, and who is about to crash
  3. Use ipratropium, dexamethasone and IM epinephrine

Textbook: Chapter 29, PDF pages 2467–2485 (drugs: 2507–2521)
slides.say: Welcome back. Last lesson we built the assessment; today we use it. As EMRs, you already sit these patients up, give oxygen, and give salbutamol by inhaler or nebulizer. As a PCP, your bronchospasm toolkit grows: ipratropium, dexamethasone and intramuscular epinephrine, plus CPAP, which you met in Chapters thirteen and fourteen. Today we'll cover three things: the infected upper airway, and why you leave it alone; asthma and COPD, and how to spot the patient who is about to crash; and the PCP drugs, with their BC doses and when to reach for each one.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎回来。上节课我们搭好了评估框架，今天来用它。作为 EMR，你们已经会扶这类病人坐起、给氧、用吸入器或雾化器给沙丁胺醇。作为 PCP，你治疗支气管痉挛的工具变多了：异丙托溴铵、地塞米松、肌注肾上腺素，还有第十三、十四章讲过的 CPAP。今天讲三件事：感染的上气道，以及为什么不要去碰它；哮喘和 COPD，以及怎么认出快要垮的病人；PCP 的药物，包括 BC 剂量和各自什么时候用。

slides.title: Infected upper airway: hands off
slides.body:
CroupEpiglottitis
Causevirusbacteria (Hib), now rare
Who, when6 months–3 years; winter, springany age, any season
Signsseal-bark coughdrooling, fever, hoarse, sniffing
Dangerrarely fatalsudden total obstruction

Don't look in the throat. If breathing fails, a careful BVM usually works.
slides.say: Let's start at the top. In children, a little swelling narrows the airway a lot, because resistance rises steeply as a tube gets narrower. Croup is a viral infection around the vocal cords, most common from six months to three years, with a cough like a seal's bark. It's distressing but rarely fatal. Epiglottitis is a fast bacterial infection that can close the airway suddenly, at any age. Look for drooling, fever, a hoarse voice and the sniffing position. For both, don't put anything in the mouth to look; if breathing fails, a careful BVM usually works. And note: BC lists croup as an indication for dexamethasone, a PCP drug.
slides.sayZh: 先从最上面说起。孩子的气道稍微一肿就窄很多，因为管子变细时阻力会急剧上升。喉炎（哮吼）是声带周围的病毒感染，多见于六个月到三岁，咳嗽像海豹叫。看着吓人，但很少致命。会厌炎是进展很快的细菌感染，可以突然把气道堵死，任何年龄都可能。表现为流口水、发热、声音嘶哑、头后仰呈嗅物位。两种情况都不要往嘴里放东西去看；如果呼吸衰竭，仔细做球囊面罩通气通常有效。另外注意：BC 把喉炎列为地塞米松的适应证，这是 PCP 的药。

slides.title: Obstructive disease: trapped air
slides.body:
Breathing out squeezes small airways shut

  • The harder they push, the more air gets trapped
  • Pursed lips: a slow, controlled breath out
  • I:E ratio stretches from 1:2 to 1:6 or 1:8
  • Belly muscles push air out; JVD from high chest pressure
  • Asthma: reversible. COPD: chronic and irreversible
slides.say: Asthma, emphysema and chronic bronchitis are the obstructive diseases, and together they affect ten to twenty percent of adults. The problem is breathing out. The pressure of exhaling pinches the small airways shut, so air gets trapped, and the harder the patient pushes, the more gets trapped. That's why they breathe out slowly through pursed lips. Normally breathing out takes twice as long as breathing in; in a very sick patient it can take six or eight times as long. They push with their belly muscles, and the high chest pressure can distend the neck veins. Asthma, at least early on, is reversible. COPD is chronic, progressive and irreversible.
slides.sayZh: 哮喘、肺气肿和慢性支气管炎是阻塞性疾病，合计影响百分之十到二十的成人。问题出在呼气：呼气的压力把小气道挤闭，气体被困住，病人越用力推，困住的越多。所以他们缩着嘴唇慢慢呼气。正常呼气时间是吸气的两倍；病得很重的人可以拉长到六倍或八倍。他们用腹肌往外推气，胸腔压力高还会让颈静脉怒张。哮喘至少在早期是可逆的；COPD 是慢性、进行性、不可逆的。

slides.title: Asthma: spasm plus swelling
slides.body:
Spasmsmooth muscle squeezesfast fix: bronchodilators
Swellinginflamed airway wallslow fix: corticosteroids
Triggersallergens, dust, cold air, exercisealso stress, infection

About 3.8 million Canadians have asthma; it's the most common chronic disease in children.
slides.say: Asthma has two parts, and they explain your drugs. The underlying problem is inflammation: the airway walls swell. On top of that come spasms of the smooth muscle around the larger bronchi, which squeeze the tubes and cause the wheeze. Spasm is the fast part, and bronchodilators like salbutamol relieve it within minutes. Swelling is the slow part, and only corticosteroids, like dexamethasone, calm it, over hours. Typical triggers are allergens, dust, perfume, cat dander, cold air, exercise and stress, and an infection can keep re-triggering attacks. About three point eight million Canadians have asthma, and it's the most common chronic disease in children.
slides.sayZh: 哮喘有两个部分，正好解释了你的用药。根本问题是炎症：气道壁肿胀。在此基础上，较大支气管周围的平滑肌发生痉挛，把管子勒紧，产生哮鸣音。痉挛是快的部分，沙丁胺醇这类支气管扩张剂几分钟就能缓解；肿胀是慢的部分，只有糖皮质激素，比如地塞米松，才能让它消下去，要几个小时。常见诱因有过敏原、灰尘、香水、猫皮屑、冷空气、运动和压力，感染也会反复诱发发作。加拿大约有三百八十万哮喘病人，它是儿童最常见的慢性病。

slides.title: The asthmatic who can die
slides.body:
• Previous near-fatal attack, ICU, or intubation
  • 2+ admissions or 3+ ER visits for asthma
  • 2+ rescue inhalers a month; poor control lately
  • Heart disease or COPD as well

Called 9-1-1? Treat as status asthmaticus

Exhausted, hyperinflated, silent chest = near arrest.
slides.say: Some asthmatics are at much higher risk of dying. Ask about a previous near-fatal attack, an ICU admission or intubation; two or more hospital admissions, or three or more emergency visits, for asthma; using two or more rescue inhalers a month; poor control lately, with night waking; and heart disease or COPD as well. Status asthmaticus is a severe, prolonged attack that normal treatment can't break. Most asthmatics don't call nine-one-one unless the attack is much worse than usual, so assume status asthmaticus until proven otherwise. The near-arrest patient is exhausted, hyperinflated and dehydrated, and the chest may be silent.
slides.sayZh: 有些哮喘病人死亡风险高得多。要问：以前有没有差点致命的发作、进过 ICU 或插过管；因哮喘住院两次以上或看急诊三次以上；一个月用掉两支以上急救吸入器；最近控制差、夜里憋醒；是否合并心脏病或 COPD。哮喘持续状态是常规治疗打不断的严重、持久发作。大多数哮喘病人除非比平时严重得多，否则不会打九一一，所以在排除之前都按哮喘持续状态处理。濒临停搏的病人筋疲力尽、胸廓过度充气、脱水，胸部可能一片寂静。

slides.q: Four asthma patients called tonight. Who is closest to respiratory arrest?
options: Loud wheezes, RR 28, speaking in short sentences
Tripod, very quiet chest, drowsy, two-word answers
Night cough, wheezing only on a forced breath out
slides.say: Time for a question. Four asthma patients called tonight. Who is closest to respiratory arrest? A, loud wheezes, a rate of twenty-eight, speaking in short sentences. B, sitting in tripod, a very quiet chest, drowsy, giving two-word answers. C, wheezing after exercise, with a saturation of ninety-five percent. D, a night cough, wheezing only on a forced breath out. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 考考你。今晚有四个哮喘病人呼救，谁最接近呼吸停止？A 哮鸣音响亮，呼吸二十八次，能说短句；B 三脚架位，胸部很安静，犯困，只能答两个词；C 运动后喘，血氧百分之九十五；D 夜间咳嗽，只在用力呼气时有哮鸣。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. A very quiet chest in a drowsy, exhausted patient means almost no air is moving, which is near-arrest. Prepare to assist ventilations while you treat. A is sick, but loud wheezes mean air is still moving. C and D describe milder disease. In asthma, a quiet chest is a warning, not a relief.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。病人犯困、筋疲力尽，胸部又很安静，说明几乎没有气体进出，已接近停搏。治疗的同时要准备辅助通气。A 也病得不轻，但哮鸣音响说明还有气流。C 和 D 是较轻的情况。哮喘时，胸部变安静是警报，不是解脱。

slides.title: COPD: find what changed
slides.body:
TriggerClues
Pneumoniafever; sputum changes colour or amount
Right heart failureedema, JVD; worse over days
Left heart failuresudden: heart attack or arrhythmia
Plain flare-upweather, heating, dust, cats, paint

Pink puffer (thin, barrel chest) or blue bloater (heavy, sputum, bluish): most are in between.
slides.say: COPD includes emphysema and chronic bronchitis. The classic emphysema patient is thin, with a barrel chest and pursed lips: the pink puffer. The classic chronic bronchitis patient is heavier, coughs up sputum every day and looks bluish: the blue bloater. Most are somewhere in between. These patients live with their disease, so a nine-one-one call means something changed. Find it. Pneumonia brings fever and a change in the sputum. Right heart failure builds over days, with swollen legs and distended neck veins. Left heart failure comes suddenly, from a heart attack or an arrhythmia, so don't let the COPD label hide an MI.
slides.sayZh: COPD 包括肺气肿和慢性支气管炎。典型肺气肿病人消瘦、桶状胸、缩唇呼吸，叫「红喘型」。典型慢支病人偏胖、每天咳痰、脸色发紫，叫「紫肿型」。大多数人介于两者之间。这些病人与病共存惯了，打九一一就说明情况变了，要找出变在哪。肺炎会有发热、痰的颜色或量改变。右心衰几天内逐渐加重，伴腿肿、颈静脉怒张。左心衰来得突然，源于心梗或心律失常，别让 COPD 这个标签掩盖了心梗。

slides.title: Oxygen and bagging in COPD
slides.body:
• Hypoxic drive is rare: never withhold needed O₂
  • BC: high-flow O₂ is indicated for COPD with SOB
  • After acute care: nasal cannula 1–3 L/min
  • Drowsy, rate dropping? Assist ventilations
  • Bagging? Let each breath fully out: auto-PEEP kills
slides.say: Now oxygen. You may have heard that oxygen can stop a COPD patient breathing. That's hypoxic drive, and it's rare, limited to a few end-stage patients, and even then the rate falls slowly, where you can see it. So never withhold oxygen from a COPD patient who needs it. BC says high-flow oxygen is indicated for COPD with shortness of breath, then a nasal cannula at one to three litres after the acute phase. If the patient gets drowsy and the rate falls, assist ventilations. And bag slowly: if each breath can't get out before the next, pressure builds up. That's auto-PEEP, and it can cause a pneumothorax or cardiac arrest.
slides.sayZh: 再说给氧。你可能听说过给氧会让 COPD 病人停止呼吸，这叫低氧驱动，很少见，只出现在少数终末期病人身上；即使发生，呼吸也是慢慢变慢，你看得到。所以需要氧的 COPD 病人绝不能扣氧。BC 规定 COPD 病人气短时就该给高流量氧，急性期过后改鼻导管每分钟一到三升。病人犯困、频率下降，就辅助通气。捏球要慢：如果每口气呼不完就送下一口，压力会越积越高，这叫内源性 PEEP，可导致气胸或心搏骤停。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: SOB with asthma / COPD
slides.body:
BC protocol: shortness of breath with a history of asthma/COPD

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Sit up, leaning forward; limit movement
  • O₂ to SpO₂ ≥ 94% (may not be achievable)
  • Auscultate; history and baseline vitals
  • Salbutamol neb or MDI; transport after 1st dose
  • Ventilated? MDI through the BVM side port

PCP adds

  • Salbutamol + ipratropium (ipratropium once)
  • IM epinephrine: SpO₂ < 90% and/or spasm unresolved
  • Consider dexamethasone
  • Consider CPAP
slides.say: You saw this protocol briefly in Chapter thirteen; now let's use it. The left column is what every licence level does: sit the patient up, leaning forward, and limit movement; give oxygen aiming for ninety-four percent, though it may not be reachable; listen to the chest, take a history and vitals; and give salbutamol by nebulizer or inhaler, starting transport after the first dose. If you're ventilating, give the inhaler through the BVM side port. The right column is yours as a PCP: ipratropium with the salbutamol; intramuscular epinephrine when the saturation is under ninety percent or the spasm won't break; and consider dexamethasone and CPAP.
slides.sayZh: 第十三章简单见过这个流程，现在来实际用它。左栏是所有执照级别都做的：扶病人坐起、身体前倾、限制活动；给氧使血氧达到百分之九十四，但可能达不到；听诊、问病史、测生命体征；用雾化器或吸入器给沙丁胺醇，第一剂后就开始转运。如果正在通气，就从球囊面罩的侧孔给吸入剂。右栏是你作为 PCP 才能做的：沙丁胺醇加异丙托溴铵；血氧低于百分之九十或痉挛缓解不了时肌注肾上腺素；并考虑地塞米松和 CPAP。

slides.title: The PCP's bronchospasm drugs
slides.body:
DrugAdult BC doseKey point
Salbutamol (EMR + PCP)5 mg neb, or 4 × 100 mcg MDIrepeat as needed
Ipratropium (PCP)500 mcg neb, or 8 × 20 mcg MDIonce only, with salbutamol
Dexamethasone (PCP)8 mg, PO preferredworks over hours
Epinephrine (PCP dose)0.5 mg IMq 5–20 min, impending arrest

Children: salbutamol neb 5 mg (2.5 mg under 1 yr); ipratropium neb 250 mcg; dexamethasone 0.5 mg/kg (max 16 mg); epinephrine 0.01 mg/kg (max 0.5 mg).
slides.say: Here are the BC adult doses. Salbutamol, which every licence level gives, is five milligrams by nebulizer, or four puffs of one hundred micrograms, repeated as needed. Ipratropium is five hundred micrograms in the same nebulizer as the salbutamol, or eight puffs of twenty micrograms, and it's given once only. Dexamethasone is eight milligrams, by mouth preferred. For severe bronchospasm with impending arrest, the PCP gives epinephrine zero point five milligrams intramuscularly, which may be repeated every five to twenty minutes. Children's doses are on the slide: weight-based for dexamethasone and epinephrine, and half a nebule of ipratropium.
slides.sayZh: 这是 BC 成人剂量。沙丁胺醇所有执照级别都能给：雾化五毫克，或吸入器每喷一百微克、喷四下，按需重复。异丙托溴铵五百微克，和沙丁胺醇放在同一个雾化器里，或吸入器每喷二十微克、喷八下，只给一次。地塞米松八毫克，首选口服。严重支气管痉挛、即将停搏时，PCP 肌注肾上腺素零点五毫克，可每五到二十分钟重复。儿童剂量在幻灯片上：地塞米松和肾上腺素按体重算，异丙托溴铵用半支。

slides.title: Why each drug works
slides.body:
Gas pedalsalbutamol: beta-2 stimulationonset about 5 min
Brake offipratropium: blocks the squeezenever on its own
BypassIM epinephrine: via the bloodwhen little air moves

Dexamethasone treats the swelling, not the spasm: its effect usually takes hours.
slides.say: Why these drugs? Think of the airway muscle as a car. Salbutamol presses the gas pedal: it stimulates beta-2 receptors and opens the airways, starting in about five minutes. The parasympathetic system is the brake, squeezing the airways tight. Ipratropium, an anticholinergic, takes the foot off the brake. That's why it adds to salbutamol, and why BC says it's not for acute bronchospasm on its own. Inhaled drugs need moving air to reach the lungs. When the patient is barely moving air, intramuscular epinephrine reaches the lungs through the blood instead. Dexamethasone treats the swelling, not the spasm, so its effect usually takes hours.
slides.sayZh: 为什么用这些药？把气道平滑肌想成一辆车。沙丁胺醇是踩油门：兴奋 β2 受体，扩张气道，约五分钟起效。副交感神经是刹车，把气道勒紧；异丙托溴铵是抗胆碱药，相当于松开刹车。所以它是给沙丁胺醇帮忙的，BC 也说明它不能单独用于急性支气管痉挛。吸入药要靠气流才能进到肺里；病人几乎不换气时，肌注肾上腺素可以经血液到达肺部。地塞米松治的是肿胀而不是痉挛，所以通常要几个小时才见效。

slides.q: A 24-year-old asthmatic has had salbutamol with ipratropium. Ten minutes later: two-word answers, faint wheezes, SpO₂ 87% on O₂, alert, BP 128/80. Next step?
options: Repeat the ipratropium with the next salbutamol
Epinephrine 0.5 mg IM, continue salbutamol, keep transporting
Give dexamethasone and wait 20 minutes for it to work
slides.say: Let's try a PCP decision. A twenty-four-year-old asthmatic has had salbutamol with ipratropium. Ten minutes later she gives two-word answers, her wheezes are faint, and her saturation is eighty-seven percent on oxygen. She's alert, with a blood pressure of one hundred twenty-eight over eighty. What's your next step? A, repeat the ipratropium with the next salbutamol. B, epinephrine zero point five milligrams IM, continue the salbutamol, and keep transporting. C, give dexamethasone and wait twenty minutes for it to work. D, start CPAP at fifteen centimetres of water. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来一道 PCP 决策题。一位二十四岁哮喘病人已用过沙丁胺醇加异丙托溴铵。十分钟后她只能答两个词，哮鸣音微弱，吸氧下血氧百分之八十七，神志清楚，血压一百二十八比八十。下一步是什么？A 下一次沙丁胺醇再加一次异丙托溴铵；B 肌注肾上腺素零点五毫克，继续沙丁胺醇，继续转运；C 给地塞米松，等二十分钟让它起效；D 以十五厘米水柱启动 CPAP。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. Her saturation is under ninety percent and the bronchospasm hasn't resolved with salbutamol, which is exactly when BC tells the PCP to consider intramuscular epinephrine. Keep the salbutamol going and reassess. A is wrong because ipratropium is a single dose. C is wrong because dexamethasone works over hours. D is wrong because BC's CPAP maximum is ten centimetres of water.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。她血氧低于百分之九十，用了沙丁胺醇痉挛仍未缓解，这正是 BC 让 PCP 考虑肌注肾上腺素的时机。继续沙丁胺醇并复评。A 错在异丙托溴铵只给一次。C 错在地塞米松要几个小时才起效。D 错在 BC 的 CPAP 上限是十厘米水柱。

slides.title: Every dose: give it well, then reassess
slides.body:
1. Neb: gas flow 6 L/min or more; stop the questions
  2. Flu-like or infectious signs? BC: MDI + spacer
  3. Spacer: suck slowly like a straw, hold the breath
  4. Reassess: breath sounds, SpO₂, RR, words
  5. Record the change, then decide the next step
slides.say: A drug only works if it reaches the small airways. A nebulizer needs at least six litres a minute of gas flow, and while it runs the patient gets only about thirty-five to forty percent oxygen, so watch the saturation. Stop the questions so the patient can breathe in the mist. With flu-like or other infectious signs, BC strongly recommends an inhaler and spacer. Coach the patient to suck slowly, as if through a straw, and hold the breath for a few seconds. After every dose, reassess the breath sounds, the saturation, the rate and how many words they can say. Record the change, then decide the next step.
slides.sayZh: 药要到达小气道才有用。雾化器需要每分钟至少六升的气流，雾化期间病人只得到约百分之三十五到四十的氧，所以要盯着血氧。别再问问题，让病人专心吸药雾。有流感样或其他感染征象时，BC 强烈建议用吸入器加储雾罐。指导病人像用吸管一样慢慢吸，再屏气几秒。每一剂之后都要复评呼吸音、血氧、呼吸频率和一口气能说几个词。记录变化，再决定下一步。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• Ipratropium: once; caution glaucoma, enlarged prostate
  • Salbutamol: caution coronary disease, heart disease in COPD, diabetes
  • Epinephrine: IM only on the BC exam; more whole-body effects
  • Dexamethasone: not with systemic fungal infection; caution in CHF
  • Wheeze + hives or low BP after an allergen: anaphylaxis
  • Wheeze + crackles, JVD, edema: think heart failure
slides.say: Now the new responsibilities. Ipratropium is a single dose, and needs caution in narrow-angle glaucoma and an enlarged prostate. Salbutamol needs caution in coronary disease, COPD with heart disease, and diabetes. On the licensing exam, epinephrine is intramuscular only; in BCEHS, a PCP with additional training may also nebulize it for croup. It affects the whole body much more than an inhaled drug. Dexamethasone is contraindicated in systemic fungal infections, and needs caution in heart failure because it can retain fluid. And a wheeze doesn't always mean asthma. Wheezing with hives or low blood pressure after an allergen is anaphylaxis: epinephrine comes first. Wheezing with crackles, distended neck veins and swollen legs may be heart failure.
slides.sayZh: 现在说新的责任。异丙托溴铵只给一次，闭角型青光眼和前列腺增生要慎用。沙丁胺醇在冠心病、合并心脏病的 COPD 和糖尿病时要慎用。执照考试里肾上腺素只能肌注（在 BCEHS，受过额外培训的 PCP 还可以雾化给药治疗哮吼），它对全身的影响比吸入药大得多。地塞米松禁用于全身性真菌感染，心衰病人要慎用，因为会导致水钠潴留。还有，有哮鸣不一定是哮喘：接触过敏原后哮鸣伴荨麻疹或低血压，是过敏性休克，先给肾上腺素；哮鸣伴湿啰音、颈静脉怒张和腿肿，可能是心衰。

slides.title: For the BC exam
slides.body:
• Book also names magnesium, IV steroids, aminophylline: not on the BC exam
  • BC epinephrine for spasm: 0.5 mg IM q 5–20 min (PCP)
  • Ipratropium single dose; salbutamol may repeat
  • COPD with SOB: high-flow O₂, later cannula 1–3 L/min
  • Anaphylaxis: salbutamol for spasm after epinephrine (PCP)
slides.say: A few BC points. The textbook mentions magnesium, intravenous steroids like methylprednisolone, and older drugs like aminophylline. None of these is on the BC exam drug list; your exam corticosteroid is dexamethasone. In BCEHS, hydrocortisone for asthma is a CCP drug; a PCP gives it only for adrenal crisis, after CliniCall. The book says epinephrine is sometimes used in life-threatening asthma; BC makes it specific: zero point five milligrams intramuscularly every five to twenty minutes for severe bronchospasm with impending arrest, a PCP dose. Ipratropium is a single dose; salbutamol may be repeated. COPD patients who are short of breath get high-flow oxygen, then a nasal cannula at one to three litres. And in the anaphylaxis protocol, the PCP treats bronchospasm with salbutamol after the epinephrine.
slides.sayZh: 几个 BC 考点。教材提到镁剂、甲泼尼龙这类静脉激素，以及氨茶碱这类老药，都不在 BC 考试药物清单里；考试里你的激素是地塞米松。在 BCEHS，哮喘用氢化可的松属于 CCP；PCP 只在肾上腺危象时、咨询 CliniCall 后才给。书里说危及生命的哮喘有时会用肾上腺素；BC 规定得很具体：严重支气管痉挛、即将停搏时，肌注零点五毫克，每五到二十分钟一次，这是 PCP 剂量。异丙托溴铵只给一次，沙丁胺醇可以重复。气短的 COPD 病人给高流量氧，之后改鼻导管一到三升。在过敏性休克流程里，PCP 是在给完肾上腺素之后，再用沙丁胺醇处理支气管痉挛。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Infected upper airway: hands off; a careful BVM if needed
  2. Asthmatic who calls = status asthmaticus; quiet chest = near arrest
  3. Salbutamol + ipratropium once, then IM epi; reassess every dose

Next: pneumonia, pulmonary edema, clots, collapsed lungs and hyperventilation
slides.say: Three things to remember. One: in an infected upper airway, keep instruments out of the mouth; if breathing fails, a careful BVM usually works. Two: an asthmatic who calls nine-one-one is in status asthmaticus until proven otherwise, and a quiet chest in a tired patient means near-arrest. Three: as a PCP you add ipratropium, once, to the salbutamol; intramuscular epinephrine when the saturation stays under ninety or the spasm won't break; and you consider dexamethasone and CPAP. Reassess after every dose. Next lesson: pneumonia, pulmonary edema, clots, collapsed lungs and hyperventilation. If anything was unclear, tap Ask.
slides.sayZh: 收尾三句话。一，感染的上气道，器械不要伸进嘴里；呼吸衰竭时，仔细做球囊面罩通气通常有效。二，打九一一的哮喘病人，在排除之前都按哮喘持续状态处理；疲惫的病人胸部安静，意味着接近停搏。三，作为 PCP，你在沙丁胺醇之外加一次异丙托溴铵；血氧持续低于九十或痉挛缓解不了时肌注肾上腺素；并考虑地塞米松和 CPAP。每一剂后都要复评。下节课讲肺炎、肺水肿、血栓、肺塌陷和过度通气。有不懂的点「Ask」。
